data.comment: Past imports column: when the file was read.

data.comment: Past imports column: how many stored bookings the run updated.

data.name: ImportHistoryColumnRowsRead
data.comment: Past imports column: how many rows the file held.

data.comment: Past imports: under the file name. {0} is the day the export was taken.

data.name: ImportHistoryExportedOnUnknown
data.comment: Past imports: under the file name, when the sheet name carried no date this version can read.

data.name: ImportHistoryPagerInfo
data.comment: Past imports pager: {0} and {1} are the first and the last run on screen, {2} the total. Keep the three numeric placeholders.

data.name: ImportSucceeded
data.comment: Headline after a file was read and its rows applied. {0} is the number of new bookings, at least one.

data.name: ImportSucceededNothingNew
data.comment: Headline after a file was read that brought no new booking, only updates or nothing.

data.name: ImportAlreadyImportedHint
data.value: Sie wurde bereits eingelesen – es hat sich nichts geändert.
data.comment: The line under the headline when the file hash matches an earlier run.

data.name: ImportAlreadyImported
data.comment: Headline when the file hash matches an earlier run. Not an error.

data.name: ImportFailed
data.comment: Headline when the file could not be read. The reasons follow as details.

data.name: ImportUnreadable
data.value: Die Datei konnte nicht gelesen werden.
data.comment: Headline when reading the upload itself failed, before the import ran.

data.name: ImportTooLarge
data.value: Die Datei ist {0} MB groß. Mehr als {1} MB werden nicht eingelesen.
data.comment: {0} is the file's size in MB, {1} the limit in MB.

data.name: ImportCountRowsRead
data.comment: {0} is the number of data rows the file carried.

data.name: ImportCountInserted
data.comment: {0} is the number of bookings stored for the first time.

data.name: ImportCountUpdated
data.comment: {0} is the number of stored bookings replaced by a later state.

data.name: ImportCountUnchanged
data.comment: {0} is the number of rows that changed nothing.

data.name: ImportUnknownColumns
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of header names CashPrism does not know.

data.name: ImportErrorNotASpreadsheet
data.value: Die Datei lässt sich nicht als Excel-Tabelle öffnen.
data.comment: The code carries the spreadsheet library's English reason as {0}. It goes to the log and is deliberately not shown.

data.name: ImportErrorNoWorksheet
data.comment: No placeholders.

data.name: ImportErrorSheetNameWithoutExportDate
data.value: Das Tabellenblatt heißt „{0}“. Erwartet wird ein Name der Form „JJJJMMTT{1}“, denn aus ihm wird das Exportdatum gelesen.
data.comment: {0} is the worksheet name, {1} the suffix that has to follow the date.

data.name: ImportErrorMissingColumns
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of header names.

data.name: ImportErrorDuplicateColumns
data.value: Diese Spalten kommen im Export mehrfach vor: {0}
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of header names.

data.name: ImportErrorEmptyValue
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} ist leer, muss aber einen Wert haben.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row.

data.name: ImportErrorNotADate
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} enthält „{2}“ statt eines Datums.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the cell's value.

data.name: ImportErrorNotAnAmount
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} enthält „{2}“ statt eines Betrags.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the cell's value.

data.name: ImportErrorAmountNotWholeCents
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} enthält „{2}“. Ein Betrag hat höchstens zwei Nachkommastellen.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the cell's value, written with a decimal point.

data.name: ImportErrorAmountTooLarge
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} enthält „{2}“, das ist zu groß für einen Betrag.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the cell's value.

data.name: ImportErrorNotAFlag
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} enthält „{2}“. Erwartet wird „{3}“ oder „{4}“.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the cell's value, {3} and {4} the export's words for yes and no.

data.name: ImportErrorUnknownSplitType
data.value: Spalte „{0}“ in Zeile {1} enthält „{2}“. Erwartet wird eines von {3} oder nichts.
data.comment: {0} is the column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the cell's value, {3} a comma-separated list of the known words.

data.name: ImportErrorSplitPartWithoutOriginal
data.value: Zeile {1} ist laut Spalte „{0}“ Teil einer aufgeteilten Buchung, aber „{2}“ nennt keine Ursprungsbuchung.
data.comment: {0} is the split-type column, {1} the worksheet row, {2} the column that should name the original booking.

data.name: ImportErrorRepeatedBookingId
data.value: Zeile {0} trägt dieselbe Buchungs-ID wie Zeile {1}. Eine Buchungs-ID darf nur einmal vorkommen.
data.comment: {0} is the row that repeats the id, {1} the row that carried it first.

data.name: ImportMoreErrors
data.value: … und {0} weitere. Die vollständige Liste steht im Konsolenfenster von CashPrism.
data.comment: {0} is how many reasons the page leaves out. All of them go to the log.
